text:
alex: Heads-up — provisioning failures hitting a small batch in eu-west1. 8 GPU nodes failing post-maint, kernel logs show Secure Boot toggled unexpectedly on some hosts.
jamie: ugh. Which rollout? the nightly BMC push?
alex: yes, the v1.4.2 BMC rollout that started ~08:12 UTC. infra-bot picked it up too.
infra-bot: [alert] firmware-rollout v1.4.2 completed on eu-west1-rack-07 (8/120 nodes). 6 success, 8 partial (secureboot flag mismatch).
marta: @alex can you paste the error from the provisioning service? need exact failure for the runbook.
alex: provisioning error: "node-alloc: failed to validate firmware state: secureboot=ENABLED expected=DISABLED"
chris: so the BMC returned a different secure boot flag than we expect. Could be a config drift in the image or a bug in the BMC tool that sets the flag.
jamie: do we see this only on that rack or spread?
alex: only rack-07 and two transient hits in rack-09 during the same window. all NVMe GPU hosts.
marta: impact? Are those nodes still attached to the cluster?
alex: nodes fail provisioning and remain in maintenance pool. from scheduler perspective we lost 136 GPUs in eu-west1 (approx 12% of region capacity).
chris: leaning into cost/availability: scheduler is auto-spreading but some tenant jobs hit soft OOMs. we should start draining affected racks from production immediately to avoid flapping when they briefly come up.
jamie: agree. We should also consider routing new allocations to eu-west2 for the next 2 hours. Cost hit but keeps SLAs.
marta: oncall assigned. I'll start a rollback plan for the BMC image on rack-07. Alex, can you gather the BMC serials + current firmware checksums?
alex: pulling now. sample ipmitool output:
```
# ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.0.7.12 -U admin -P **** mc info
Device ID : 32
Firmware Revision : 1.4.2
Manufacturer ID : 42817
```
and racadm to read secureboot: `racadm get BIOS.SecureBoot` returns ENABLED on the 8 hosts.
chris: good. Runbook PR-233 covers secureboot mismatch rollback. Steps: 1) mark rack-07 maintenance 2) reflash previous BMC image 1.4.1 via OOB controller 3) validate secureboot disabled 4) reprovision test host 5) return to rotation.
jamie: who has keys for the OOB firmware bucket? we need to avoid manual download errors.
alex: I have access. I'll stage 1.4.1 to the staging bucket and open a signed download.
marta: allocate 30m for the rollback window, coordinate with oncall SREs. Chris, start a capacity re-route to eu-west2 and notify customers that may be impacted.
chris: doing re-route now. Patch in router: `route-policy set region-priority eu-west2>eu-west1` — will keep cost center alerted.
jamie: quick check on why secureboot toggled: any chance the 1.4.2 script defaulted to ENABLE?
alex: preliminary look: the image contains a new BMC default that enforces BIOS lockdown which flips SecureBoot to ENABLE unless explicitly set. The toggle was documented in vendor notes but our deploy omitted the config step.
marta: noted. Add a validation step to the rollout pipeline to check SecureBoot state before promoting.
infra-bot: [ticket opened] TICKET-4892 created for rollback + postmortem. Assigned: marta, alex, chris.
alex: starting staged rollback on rack-07 now — flashing in parallel 4 at a time per runbook. will post progress.
chris: thanks. I'll keep routing and capacity changes pinned until we validate.
jamie: after rollback, we should run a quick audit across other regions to ensure not silently toggled anywhere else.
marta: agreed, add a global check job. Alex, update the ticket with checksums and racadm outputs.
alex: will do. first 4 nodes reflash complete, secureboot now reports DISABLED on them. re-provisioning test host passed.
marta: great. schedule: finish remaining in 25m, then monitored return to rotation.
chris: cost estimate: routing to eu-west2 adds approx $420/hr for the next 2 hours — heads-up to finance.
jamie: thanks — I'll cc finance on the incident update. :spiral_note_pad:
alex: final note — adding an automated preflight in the deploy pipeline to query `racadm get BIOS.SecureBoot` and reject image promotion if mismatch found.
marta: good. closing for now, keep updates in TICKET-4892. :white_check_mark:
